label: late original steps / <DEL> in sequences starting with y
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.009% of steps). About 85% of activation mass is in sequences whose first original token is y; a smaller share is in sequences starting with 1. It fires only at original-phase steps with t >= 4 (peak at orig_idx 6) and at the <DEL> step, so it is active when output y is about to begin. It never fires in the copy phase or at t < 4. Activations are mostly on first occurrences of a token and in sequences with few digits; an s early in the sequence and a preceding g/i/u/p/t are enriched. Precision is very low (~1%): only a small, hard-to-characterize subset of y-initial sequences activate it, and adding s/prev-token conditions raises precision only to ~13% while recall drops a lot. The predicate gives the context, not the exact trigger. Magnitude is fairly uniform (median 0.12, max 0.23).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=y (+5.93), prev_tok=g (+4.26), prev_tok=u (+3.39), prev_tok=i (+3.35), orig1=s (+3.04), orig0=1 (+3.00). Lower it: correct=1 (-5.27), phase=2 (-3.37), t=3 (-3.17), prev3_tok=- (-2.83).
